design_rationale:
WORKLOG / DOSSIER — task 0 (retail_claims_and_reimbursements), frozen 2026-10-06 14:35:00 EDT.

1. Draw (scripts/draw_counts.py --task 0): prerequisite_problems=2, factor_counts=[4,4,5]. Assignment: retail_ext_paper_claim_reimbursement 4, retail_ext_review_bridge_supply 4, retail_ext_vacation_supply_days 5 (root).

2. Why this is a good test. The member asks only for a vacation supply of Ubrelvy before a nine-week trip. The published rule of the vacation supply carries two prerequisite sentences: 'The vacation supply is fixed only after the benefit carries an emergency supply for the drug for each of its coverage reviews still awaiting decision.' and 'A vacation supply is not sized until each paper claim on the benefit for the drug has been decided.' The agent must read the records (an undecided paper claim received 2026-09-25 for a Halifax purchase; a Ubrelvy renewal case opened 2026-09-28 with no decision while the approval expired 2026-09-30; no emergency-supply override), discover that the only writes that bring those states about are the paper-claim approval and the review bridge, notice that the bridge itself waits on the paper-claim decision ('The review bridge is not worked out until every paper claim filed on the benefit for the drug under review carries its decision.'), and resolve approval -> bridge -> vacation, each with its own multi-factor computation. Difficulty comes from reading policy and records and calculating; every tool is named by its policy's target_tool, so tool choice is never the difficulty.

3. Scope. Occupied before: nothing (first task). Claimed: retail_ext_paper_claim_reimbursement (approve_paper_claim_1f52e397, agent), retail_ext_review_bridge_supply (grant_review_bridge_supply_635c815d, agent), retail_ext_vacation_supply_days (request_vacation_supply_35815dad, user). Reserved headroom for task 1 (draw: 1 prerequisite, factors [6,5]): the lost-or-stolen replacement (member's own report) and the dose-change override, a tree disjoint from every asset here.

4. Problem-tree card. Root retail_ext_vacation_supply_days. Edges: (a) vacation <- bridge, value_input, gate 'pending', state form, condition 'an emergency_supply override for the drug stands while a review case is pending'; false at opening: review_cases 19da6fd7 (opened 2026-09-28) has no decision row and the only override is vacation supply 4fed307a; resolved by grant_review_bridge_supply_635c815d (only write in this difficulty that creates an emergency_supply override). (b) vacation <- approval, value_input, gate 'on_hand', state form (negated direction); false: submission ef389d67 has no decision row; resolved by approve_paper_claim_1f52e397 (only decision-writing tool in the difficulty). (c) bridge <- approval, value_input, gate 'on_hand', state form (negated); same seed evidence. Topological order: approval (step 15) -> bridge (step 17) -> vacation (step 19); unique, since edge (c) orders the two prerequisites. Deletion sensitivity (sensitivity run; values recomputed by check_compute): skip approval -> bridge 22 (not 14), vacation 31 (not 16); skip bridge -> vacation 30. Four-point test on each sentence: explicit connective ('only after', 'not ... until'), record-visible state (an emergency supply standing on the benefit; a paper claim carrying its decision), no tool/policy id/code token, scope 'for the drug' and 'each/every paper claim' exactly as the condition. Directions: affirmative for the vacation<-bridge sentence, negated for the two decision sentences — the desk would say a supply 'is not sized until' a claim is decided. user_scenario never names the paper-claim decision, an approval, a renewal or a bridge; the Halifax purchase surfaces only if the agent asks. Tools block nothing: each task tool is a single ctx.create (plus the balance update of the approval) and never reads another problem's rows to refuse.

5. Factor cards (tier in this world -> baseline figure of result).
 Paper claim (expected 520.27; whole baseline 853.40): purchase_place_days [parameter] foreign -> 112 limited to max_days_supply_retail 90 (baseline 670.88); previous_fill_overlap [method] Halifax DOS 2026-06-24 is day 16 of the 2026-06-08 30-day claim, before the 22.5-day threshold -> minus 14 = 76 days (baseline 616.11); allowed_amount_basis [method] foreign -> 958.40 x 76/112 x 0.8 = 520.27 (baseline network rate 1029.66/30 x 76 capped at 958.40 -> 958.40); accumulator_cost_share [parameter, plan] oop_met 2500.00 = Plus maximum 2500.00 -> 0 (baseline tier-2 copay 35 x 3.0 = 105 -> 415.27). Near-miss: the 2026-04-09 60-day claim is not the most recent network claim and must not anchor the overlap; using it would give no overlap.
 Bridge (expected 14; baseline 5): case_opening_bridge [parameter, cross-difficulty review; its two conditions are fields of one case row] standard + member-opened -> 7 (baseline 5 -> 12); information_request_extension [parameter, review] two requests 2026-09-29 and 2026-10-02 without receipt -> 2 x 5 = 10 (baseline 0 -> 4); home_delivery_extension [parameter, cross-difficulty mail, multi-source] HD-7730415 on file + account active -> 5 (baseline 0 -> 9); bridge_supply_anchor [method] the approved Halifax paper-claim fill is the fill held -> 8 days on hand (baseline: most recent paid network claim, run out -> 0 -> 22); the netting max(0, horizon - on hand) is fixed plumbing stated in the baseline. Near-miss: the 2025 PA case (f0057d45) is decided and has no information requests; only the latest opened case sets priority/requester.
 Vacation (expected 16; baseline 90): held_fill_anchor [method] approved paper-claim fill later than the network claim -> 8 on hand (baseline 0 -> 24); authorised_supply_offset [method] unused 14-day bridge -> 14 (baseline 0 -> 30); review_status_ceiling [parameter, cross-difficulty review, multi-source expired approval AND pending case] -> 90 x 0.67 rounded down = 60 (baseline 90 -> 46); recent_vacation_reduction [parameter] vacation supply 2026-04-08 within six months -> 15 (baseline 0 -> 31); carried_early_days [method] 14 carried days, above early_grace_days 7, within the 15-day limit -> 7 (baseline 0 -> 23). 60 - 8 - 14 - 15 - 7 = 16.

6. Base-invariant card. Approval subject retail_dmr_approved: retail_evt_dmr.filed_on_time (anchor retail_reimbursements.date_of_service 2026-06-24, 365 days Open Choice, day zero = DOS, inclusive; received 2026-09-25 = day 93; boundary 2027-06-24 ok, 2027-06-25 late) and decide_once (no approval/denial row references ef389d67). Overrides subject retail_override_granted: retail_evt_override.override_open_benefit (benefit debb4d73 active) and vacation_lead_time (departure 2026-10-17 stated by the member; 2026-10-06 is 11 days before, inside the 14-day lead; second vacation supply of the plan year, within Open Choice's 2; Ubrelvy is not controlled). Emergency supply also requires a pending coverage review (case 19da6fd7, no decision) and at most 2 per drug per plan year (none yet). The paper claim is payable: approval 83ebe5ea (2025-10-01..2026-09-30) was in force on 2026-06-24; Open Choice covers foreign purchases; no paid network claim on 2026-06-24.

7. Business-object card. Paper claim: the single submission ef389d67 (source_reimbursement_id). Network claims of RX-4418203: 8 rows 2025-10-10..2026-06-08; the most recent (957f5f92, 2026-06-08) anchors overlap and rate. Override rows: April vacation supply 4fed307a (used by claim a266ba73). Review rows: 2025 case f0057d45 + approval 18bd7db4 -> authorization 83ebe5ea; renewal 19da6fd7 with info requests 824cce15, 881d863a. Plan ledger: 2025 copays (3), 2026 copays (2), medical feed 2430.00 -> oop_met 2500.00 equals the ledger sum. Trigger safety: the approval writes deductible 0.00 and member cost share 0.00, so neither plan posting trigger's 'when' is met; overrides have no triggers.

8. Persona design. Brisk, list-keeping engineer; opens with the surface goal only; gives member ID and DOB on request (verification K=2); phone/email/ZIP as spares; reads Rx RX-4418203 off her label if asked; departure 2026-10-17, return about December 19 (not in gold); Halifax purchase only if asked; consents to whatever must be handled first; runs the handed-over vacation request with the agent's figures and closes. No template labels; no computed figure appears in the persona.

9. Standard solution and recomputation. Reads: customer, verify, retail benefit, claims, reimbursements, overrides, plan enrollment, accumulator ledger, formulary assignment, review program, review cases, authorizations, mail account, mail prescriptions. Writes: approve ef389d67 (allowed 520.27, deductible 0.00, cost share 0.00, reimbursement 520.27) -> bridge RX-4418203 14 days -> member records vacation RX-4418203, departure 2026-10-17, 16 days. Gates run (per task): check_extended, check_task_tools, replay_tasks, check_solvability, check_compute (recompute 520.27 / 14 / 16, factor and baseline figures as above), check_grounding, check_cross_fire — all OK.

10. Draft recomputation from the visible context: the published rule texts plus the finder returns give the same three writes in the same order and the same figures; the only judgement call (approve vs deny) is fixed by the base denial reasons, none of which applies.

Revisions: (r1) closure mismatch — ledger and formulary rows were outside the gold reads: added both reads (they feed the cost-share factor's out-of-pocket reconciliation and the tier); dropped the unread sponsor profile and blanked sponsor references. (r2) replaced_by of the first overwrite quoted two non-contiguous sentences; narrowed to the reimbursed-days sentence. (r3) date helper in task_tools.py was read as a tool; inlined.

Round-2 rework (audit audits/policy_task/retail_claims_and_reimbursements):
 (CG-2) symptom: the bridge's only method factor (on_hand_netting) was one subtraction with a floor, not a ladder. Change: netting is now fixed plumbing in the baseline ('The review bridge is the bridge horizon less the supply on hand for the bridge, never below zero'), and the method factor is bridge_supply_anchor, which picks the fill held: approved paper claim later than every network claim / reversed most recent network claim (count nothing) / most recent network claim. Re-run: bridge still 14; anchor baseline 22; factors 4 (3 parameter, 1 method).
 (CG-8) symptom: the bridge baseline left both extensions without a value. Change: the baseline now states 'The information extension of the bridge and the delivery extension of the bridge are zero days.' and the on-hand and netting sentences, so the computation document alone gives 5 + 0 + 0 - 0 = 5 on this world.
 (CG-5) the urgent tier is now emergency_supply_days less urgent_bridge_reduction_days (2), at least one day, so it differs from the fall-through on every network. Not exercised here (the case is standard).
 (CG-4) the pending-review vacation ceiling is now vacation_override_max_days_supply x pending_review_vacation_share (0.67), rounded down, so it never exceeds the base 'for up to vacation_override_max_days_supply days' and differs from the fall-through on every network (30 -> 20, 60 -> 40, 90 -> 60). Here 90 x 0.67 = 60.3 -> 60; vacation unchanged at 16.
 (CG-3) the paper-claim member cost share now carries the deductible portion the base pricing includes, read from the plan (deductible_individual or deductible_family less deductible_met, on deductible tiers, insulin exemption honoured); above 60 reimbursed days the multiple is band_61_90_multiplier only where retail_90_allowed is true, otherwise one 30-day cost share per 30 days or part, declared as an overwrite of retail_claim_cost_share. Here Rx Plus has no deductible and the out-of-pocket maximum is met: approval unchanged at 520.27 (baseline 853.40).
 (O-4) the vacation offset's second tier now reads 'when the most recent emergency supply for the drug has already been used by a claim', matching compute. (O-5) tool docstrings no longer use before/after wording. (O-2) the clm_dos quotation case fixed.
 Gates re-run after the rework: see the worklog.

Round-3 rework (audit revision 2; this task passed and is unchanged in value):
 (CG-9) the paper-claim deductible portion now uses the member's own deductible remaining (individual deductible less deductible met on the active enrollment). The deviation from the plan's deductible rule (family accumulation, Preventive Drug List exemption) is stated in the rule and declared as an overwrite of retail_claim_cost_share's 'after any deductible portion, which the plan's deductible rule sets'. Here Rx Plus has no deductible tiers: deductible portion 0.00.
 (CG-10) the coinsurance tier cost share is now raised to the tier's per-fill minimum, lowered to its per-fill maximum where those are not zero, and capped at the allowed amount less the deductible portion, as plan_cost_share sets. Here tier 2 is a copay tier: tier cost share 105.00, unchanged.
 (O-7) the vacation rule's closing sentence now says nothing is rounded apart from rounding the pending-review ceiling down.
 Re-run: approval 520.27, bridge 14, vacation 16; baselines 853.40 / 5 / 90; factor figures unchanged.
user_scenario: You are Delphine Okafor-Brennagh, a 55-year-old kiln and process engineer from Westerville, Ohio, covered through your employer, Olentangy Ridge Ceramics Cooperative. You are organised, a little brisk, and you speak like someone who keeps lists. You take Ubrelvy 100 mg tablets for migraines and fill them at the Kroger pharmacy in Westerville. Your company is sending you to a client plant in Santiago, Chile for about nine weeks; your itinerary says you leave on 2026-10-17. You are calling Northbridge Rx because you want a vacation supply of your Ubrelvy set up so you are covered while you are away, and you open with exactly that: you are travelling for work for a couple of months and need extra Ubrelvy before you go. You give your member ID, NBX104827316, as soon as the agent asks how to find you, and your date of birth, 1971-05-19, when asked to confirm who you are; if a further detail is wanted you can give your phone number, 614-555-0113, your email, delphine.okaforbrennagh@lumenmail.net, or your ZIP code, 43085. If the agent asks for the prescription number, you read it off your Kroger label: RX-4418203. If asked when you leave, you say 2026-10-17, and if asked when you come back, around December 19. If the agent asks whether you have filled Ubrelvy anywhere other than Kroger, you mention, only then, that you spent the summer in Nova Scotia, bought a supply at a pharmacy in Halifax in late June and mailed Northbridge the claim form with the receipt in September; you do not know what happened to it. If asked how many tablets you have left, you say you are not sure, maybe a week or so. You do not know anything about approvals, reviews or internal rules, and you never suggest that something else has to be handled first. Whatever the agent says Northbridge needs to take care of on your account before the vacation supply can be set up, you tell them to go ahead and do it. When the agent tells you the vacation request is something you record yourself and hands it to you, you submit it with your departure date 2026-10-17 and with exactly the benefit reference, prescription number and number of days the agent gives you, and you read back what the confirmation says. You do not do it before the agent hands it to you, and you do not invent a number of days yourself. Once the vacation request is recorded, you thank the agent and end the call; you do not raise anything else.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Locate the caller's member profile from the member ID she reads off her card; returns her customer reference number, date of birth, phone and email on file.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: Every later read and write is keyed on the customer reference number; nothing else locates her account.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Verify the caller with two credentials she states (date of birth and member ID).
evaluation_criteria.necessity: Identity must be verified before account details are discussed or any business is transacted.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read the retail benefit: its reference number, the network (Northbridge Open Choice Network, whose parameters set the vacation ceiling, emergency days, out-of-network rate and refill thresholds) and its active status.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: The benefit id is the target of all three writes and the network tier supplies every P() parameter; the active status is the override and paper-claim state gate.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read the Ubrelvy claim history: the most recent paid network claim (2026-06-08, 30 days, allowed 1029.66, prescription RX-4418203) and the earlier fills.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: The paper-claim overlap and network rate, the bridge's and the vacation supply's supply on hand and the carried early days all rest on the most recent paid network claim; the prescription number is copied into both override writes.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read the paper-claim records: the 2026-09-25 submission for a 112-day Ubrelvy purchase in Canada on 2026-06-24 (958.40 USD) that has no decision row yet.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: This is the unmet state the bridge's and the vacation's prerequisite sentences wait on (a paper claim without its decision), and it carries every receipt figure the reimbursement is priced from.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read the overrides on the benefit: the vacation supply granted 2026-04-08 for Ubrelvy and no emergency supply.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: The recent-vacation reduction rests on the April vacation supply; the absence of an emergency supply is the unmet state the vacation's prerequisite sentence waits on.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read the active plan enrollment: Northbridge Rx Plus, out-of-pocket met 2500.00.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: The member-cost-share factor of the paper claim compares the out-of-pocket met with the plan's individual out-of-pocket maximum.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read the 2026 accumulator postings: Ubrelvy copays 35.00 on 2026-01-09 and 2026-02-08 and the 2430.00 medical-carrier feed of 2026-02-17 that bring out-of-pocket to 2500.00.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: Reconciles the out-of-pocket met the member-cost-share factor compares with the individual maximum, from the ledger rather than the cached total.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read the formulary assignment: Northbridge Broad Formulary, on which Ubrelvy is tier 2.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: Confirms the tier the submission carries, which selects the tier cost share in the paper-claim baseline.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read the review program: Northbridge Clinical Advanced (its info_request_wait_days sets the information extension).
evaluation_criteria.necessity: The information-extension factor of the bridge reads the review program's information wait.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read the Ubrelvy review cases: the renewal opened 2026-09-28 by the member at standard priority with two information requests and no receipt or decision.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: This is the coverage review still awaiting decision (the bridge's eligibility and its base-days and information-extension factors) and the pending case the vacation ceiling looks at.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read the Ubrelvy prior authorization: in force 2025-10-01 through 2026-09-30.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: The vacation ceiling factor reads that the latest approval has expired.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read the home delivery account: Northbridge Home Delivery Standard, active.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: The delivery-extension factor of the bridge reads the account status.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read the prescriptions on file at home delivery: Ubrelvy 100 mg tablet, HD-7730415.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: The delivery-extension factor applies only when the drug is on file at home delivery.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Unlock the paper-claim approval tool.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: First half of the unlock/call pair; no DB effect.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Record the approval of the pending Canadian paper claim at 520.27 USD and raise the reimbursement owed on the benefit.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: retail_ext_paper_claim_reimbursement computes reimbursement_amount; its approval is the state the bridge and the vacation supply wait on.

argument_uniqueness_tracing.source_reimbursement_id: Value ef389d67-ffe6-427f-9678-17127576d9d8. Basis: the docstring 'the reference number of the paper-claim submission being decided, read from the member's paper-claim records'; find_retail_reimbursements returns exactly one retail_dmr_submitted row on the benefit (received 2026-09-25, Ubrelvy, 112 days) and no decision row points at it. Uniqueness: it is the only submission on the benefit, so every correct agent passes this id.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.allowed_amount: Value 520.27 = the policy's allowed binding: foreign purchase -> 958.40 x (90 - 14) / 112 x 0.8 = 520.27 (receipt 958.40 and 112 days from the submission; 90 = max_days_supply_retail of the Open Choice network; 14 = overlap with the 2026-06-08 network claim; 0.8 = oon_reimbursement_rate).
argument_uniqueness_tracing.deductible_amount: Value 0.00. Basis: the paper-claim rule 'The deductible portion of the paper claim is, when the receipt's formulary tier is one the plan's deductible applies to ..., the lesser of the allowed amount of the paper claim and the deductible remaining'; Northbridge Rx Plus has deductible_individual 0 and deductible_applies_to_tiers [] (plan charter), so the deductible portion is zero, and the member cost share is zero in any case because oop_met 2500.00 has reached oop_max_individual 2500.00 ('when the out-of-pocket met on the member's active plan enrollment has reached the plan's individual out-of-pocket maximum, it is zero'). Uniqueness: no deductible portion can exist, so 0.00 is the only value.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.member_cost_share: Value 0.00 = the policy's cost_share binding: accumulator_cost_share tier 'out-of-pocket maximum reached' (2500.00 >= 2500.00) -> 0; any other value contradicts that sentence.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.reimbursement_amount: Value 520.27 = RND(MX(0, MN(allowed 520.27, receipt 958.40) - cost share 0), 2): purchase_place_days 90, previous_fill_overlap -14 -> 76 days, allowed_amount_basis foreign 958.40 x 76/112 x 0.8, accumulator_cost_share 0.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Unlock the review-bridge (emergency supply) tool.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: First half of the unlock/call pair; no DB effect.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Grant the 14-day emergency supply that bridges the pending Ubrelvy renewal.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: retail_ext_review_bridge_supply computes days_supply_allowed on the world after the approval; the bridge is the state the vacation supply waits on.

argument_uniqueness_tracing.retail_benefit_id: Value debb4d73-1261-4f45-b6a9-ea0aa4ba3d1e. Basis: docstring 'the reference number of the member's retail pharmacy network benefit, read from the member's retail benefit record'; find_retail_benefits returns one benefit for the member. Uniqueness: the only retail benefit.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.rx_number: Value RX-4418203. Basis: the policy rule 'it is recorded against the prescription number of the member's most recent paid network claim for that drug'; the 2026-06-08 Ubrelvy claim carries rx_number RX-4418203 (find_retail_claims). Uniqueness: every Ubrelvy network claim carries this number; HD-7730415 is the home delivery prescription and is not a paid network claim.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.days_supply_allowed: Value 14 = the review bridge: horizon 7 (standard case opened by the member) + 10 (two outstanding information requests x info_request_wait_days 5) + 5 (prescription on file at an active home delivery account) = 22, less 8 days on hand from the approved 2026-06-24 Halifax fill (112 - 104).

evaluation_criteria.objective: Unlock the member's vacation-supply request so it can be handed to her.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: First half of the unlock/call pair; no DB effect.

evaluation_criteria.objective: The member records her own vacation-supply request for 16 days with her 2026-10-17 departure date.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: retail_ext_vacation_supply_days computes days_supply_allowed after both prerequisites are resolved; the member's own write closes the root problem.

argument_uniqueness_tracing.retail_benefit_id: Value debb4d73-1261-4f45-b6a9-ea0aa4ba3d1e. Basis: docstring 'as the agent reads it from the member's retail benefit record and gives it to the member'; find_retail_benefits returns one benefit. Uniqueness: the only retail benefit.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.rx_number: Value RX-4418203. Basis: rule 'recorded against that claim's prescription number' (the most recent paid network claim, 2026-06-08 Ubrelvy, rx_number RX-4418203). Uniqueness: the only prescription number on the member's paid network claims.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.departure_date: Value 2026-10-17. Basis: user_scenario 'your itinerary says you leave on 2026-10-17'; docstring 'the date the member leaves on the trip, as the member states it, written YYYY-MM-DD'. Uniqueness: the only departure date the member gives.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.days_supply_allowed: Value 16 = MX(0, ceiling 60 (approval expired 2026-09-30 and renewal awaiting decision: vacation_override_max_days_supply 90 x pending_review_vacation_share 0.67 = 60.3, rounded down) - on hand 8 (approved Halifax fill) - authorised 14 (unused emergency supply from step 17) - recent vacation 15 (vacation supply 2026-04-08) - carried early days 7 (14 - early_grace_days 7)) = 16.

factor_trace: purchase_place_days (parameter): the submission ef389d67 is foreign_purchase=true; tier 'purchase made outside the United States' -> receipt days 112 limited to max_days_supply_retail 90 (Open Choice) = 90; baseline (receipt days) would give 112 and a reimbursement of 670.88.

previous_fill_overlap (method): most recent paid network claim 2026-06-08 (30 days); receipt DOS 2026-06-24 is day 16, before the refill threshold 30 x 0.75 = 22.5; tier 'before the refill threshold' -> the whole overlap 30 - 16 = 14 days is taken off: 90 - 14 = 76 reimbursed days; baseline (keep 90) would give 616.11.

allowed_amount_basis (method): foreign purchase -> 958.40 x 76 / 112 x oon_reimbursement_rate 0.8 = 520.27; baseline (network rate per day 1029.66/30 x 76 = 2608.47, capped at 958.40) would give 958.40.

accumulator_cost_share (parameter): plan enrollment 1235cef5 oop_met 2500.00 >= Northbridge Rx Plus oop_max_individual 2500.00 -> cost share 0.00; baseline (tier cost share: tier 2 copay 35 x day-supply multiple 3.0 for 76 days = 105.00) would give 415.27.
plumbing: clm_drug Ubrelvy, clm_paid 958.40, clm_tier '2'; units 3.0; tier_cs 105.00; result = RND(MX(0, MN(520.27, 958.40) - 0), 2) = 520.27.

factor_sensitivity.tier_taken: the receipt is for a purchase made outside the United States
the receipt's date of service came before the refill threshold of the most recent paid network claim
the receipt is for a purchase made outside the United States
the out-of-pocket met has reached the plan's individual out-of-pocket maximum

factor_trace: case_opening_bridge (parameter, cross-difficulty review): the most recently opened Ubrelvy case 19da6fd7 is standard and requested_by member -> member_request_bridge_days 7; baseline emergency_supply_days 5 would give 12. (Its two conditions are two fields of one case row.)

information_request_extension (parameter, cross-difficulty review): info requests 2026-09-29 and 2026-10-02 on the case (rows 824cce15, 881d863a) with no receipt -> 2 outstanding -> 2 x info_request_wait_days 5 (Northbridge Clinical Advanced) = 10; baseline 0 would give 4.

home_delivery_extension (parameter, cross-difficulty mail, multi-source prescription on file AND account status): Ubrelvy prescription HD-7730415 on file at home delivery and the Northbridge Home Delivery Standard account active -> mail_transit_bridge_days 5; baseline 0 would give 9.

bridge_supply_anchor (method): after the approval at step 15 the approved Halifax paper claim (DOS 2026-06-24, 112 days) is later than every paid network claim (latest 2026-06-08) -> its days not yet run out are counted: 112 - 104 = 8; baseline (the most recent paid network claim 957f5f92, 30 days from 2026-06-08, run out) counts 0 and gives 22.
plumbing: horizon = 7 + 10 + 5 = 22; review bridge = max(0, 22 - 8) = 14 (fixed netting, not a factor).

factor_sensitivity.tier_taken: the pending case is standard and was opened by the member
two or more information requests outstanding
prescription on file at home delivery and the account active
an approved paper claim for the drug is dated later than every paid network claim for it

factor_trace: held_fill_anchor (method): the approved Halifax paper claim (DOS 2026-06-24, 112 days) is later than the 2026-06-08 network claim -> supply on hand 112 - 104 = 8; baseline (most recent paid network claim, 30 - 120 < 0) gives 0 and a vacation supply of 24.
authorised_supply_offset (method): the emergency supply granted at step 17 (14 days, granted 2026-10-06, no claim references it) -> 14 taken off; baseline 0 would give 30.

review_status_ceiling (parameter, cross-difficulty review, multi-source): the Ubrelvy approval expired 2026-09-30 (before 2026-10-06) and the renewal case has no decision -> vacation_override_max_days_supply 90 x pending_review_vacation_share 0.67 = 60.3, rounded down to 60; baseline vacation_override_max_days_supply 90 would give 46.
